_comment: WHO OWNS WHICH AGENT — hand-maintained. Edit this file directly.
Used by the review UI (scripts/review_server.py) to highlight the transcripts that are
yours, so you can find your rows without reading every line. It has NO effect on
permissions, on who may review what, or on anything Foundry does. It is a convenience.
This is NOT contributors.json. That file is generated from GitHub team membership and is
overwritten by scripts/sync_contributors.py — anything added there by hand is lost. This
file is the opposite: nothing generates it, so it is safe to edit and it is the only place
default_owner  gets every agent not listed in by_agent. So adding a new agent needs no
change here; it is owned by default until someone says otherwise.
by_agent       overrides, keyed by the transcript's `answered_by` value:
A value may be one username or a list of them.
Names must match a `github` value in contributors.json, or the UI ignores them and says
so on the review page rather than silently highlighting nothing.
